instruction.text: Now you are in a bedroom, "move forward" and "take right" and "take left", walk between the bed and a T.V set, you can find entrance in front of you, walk, you can find three cupboards to the right side "take right", exit through an open door and "move forward" you can see a mirror to the left side of a wall and entrance in front of you, exit through an open door and "take left" enter into a room, "move forward" you can find washbasin to your right side stop,this is your end point.
